Esri World Imagery 2026-11-20 (200 m half-width): a gravel lollipop loop on the west bank of the North Platte; the loop's east side runs ~13-20 m from a side channel and the loop's north tip ~20 m from the main channel, with a continuous willow band (~8-12 m) between road and water; toilet/parking pad at ~42.6823,-106.6230; pin 42.68255993,-106.6232717 at the loop junction

note: Small BLM campground and picnic area on the North Platte River about 12 miles from Alcova: WY-220 east 7.4 miles, then 4.2 miles on County Road 316 (washboard). Tent pads at the sites; bank fishing. A 23-ft-plus trailer has fit, but check the loop before pulling in. --Claude
summary: BLM page read: 4 FCFS sites, vault toilet, no water, $10 (confirmed; fees note that repeated the rate cleared). rec.gov POI is information-only. Riverview holds (willow band between the loop and the river). Pin, phone and both links good. Note trimmed of the site count.
flags: WATERFRONT stored 'riverview' (check-hard): HOLDS. The loop's east side is only ~13-20 m from a side channel of the North Platte (north tip ~20 m from the main channel), but a continuous willow band (~8-12 m) stands between every part of the loop and the water - a view value by rule. Sites unnumbered; FCFS. A reviewer might call the willow fringe low enough for riverfront; on the rule it stays a view.
